title: Form for licenses.
bodyText: The form of every license shall be prescribed by the contractors license board and shall be issued in the name of the board.
bodyHtml: §444-13  Form for licenses.  The form of every license shall be prescribed by the contractors license board and shall be issued in the name of the board. [L 1957, c 305, §1(s 12); Supp, §166A-12; HRS §444-13]
